phrases.text: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant
phrases.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ

phrases.text: Did He not frustrate their scheme
For He sent against them flocks of birds
that pelted them with stones of baked clay
leaving them like chewed up straw
